item.question: How does a T-maze experiment illustrate action selection in cognitive science?
item.answer: A T-maze experiment illustrates action selection by presenting an agent, such as a mouse, with choices at a junction. The agent uses cues and past experiences to decide which path to take, demonstrating decision-making processes and learning mechanisms.
